# Research-only source provenance

The model and stream adapters adapt the local kws-pipeline isolated donor_fsmn research components, implementing WeKws commit 6a45aeb994dd81c0969ff877a5a7c46d60ed0c86. FSMN original authors Yueyue Nyy and Jing Du; streaming decoder original copyright 2023 Jing Du. Apache-2.0 licenses are retained. The Hamming frontend adapts the isolated donor_fbank component and pinned torchaudio Kaldi feature source; its BSD-2-Clause license is retained. SHA256 utility comes from the same local Apache-2.0 repository. Exact copied source origins are retained in source-origin.json; all execution-bearing source and binary bindings appear in reviewed per-stage protocols.

A20 is the separately trained private research endpoint from the existing user-authorized D20 weak-supervision experiment, descended from official iic/speech_charctc_kws_phone-xiaoyun. Its frozen state is read-only. This research workspace contains the private endpoint payload, synthetic derived tensors and saved actual-audio traces. Stage C reference NPZ files include input PCM; do not treat the complete workspace as an audio-free distribution. User-facing evidence packages must explicitly inventory their contents and remain private. No human hearing quotes or new public distribution are authorized. The provider model's license does not establish rights in unknown pretraining audio.

No component is promoted into the default product build, registry, RNN ABI or deployment path. The source implements only a research candidate, and a failed numerical stage must not be suppressed. Host sizes and measurements do not qualify SSC305/A32, continuous FAR, FRR, end-to-end latency or real-world operation.
